root_cause.text: The volume label stored in `sbi->volume.label` after conversion via `utf16s_to_utf8s()` is not null-terminated, causing an out-of-bounds read when the label is later displayed with `%s` if the converted data fills the entire fixed-size buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit null termination after the conversion, handling three cases: error (set `label[0] = 0`), full buffer (`label[sizeof - 1] = 0`), and normal (`label[err] = 0`), confirming that `utf16s_to_utf8s()` does not add a trailing NUL and that a full buffer would lack space for it.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing null-termination of the NTFS volume label after successful UTF-16 to UTF-8 conversion.
intent_record.what: Added else-if and else branches after the error check for utf16s_to_utf8s result to explicitly null-terminate the volume label buffer in all cases: if err >= sizeof(label), set the last byte to 0; otherwise set label[err] to 0.
intent_record.how: Ensures the volume label is always a properly null-terminated string after conversion, preventing buffer over-read when the label is not truncated or exactly fills the buffer.
